content: Dev Chatterjee called insurance agent Neha Kapoor to discuss the renewal of his HomeShield policy, which has an annual premium of $1,250 with a 5% loyalty discount. They discussed payment timing to ensure coverage starts on 01/10/2026 without a gap. Neha sent a secure payment link via email and SMS, but Dev encountered an issue where the CVV field incorrectly requested 4 digits instead of 3. Neha corrected the error and sent a new payment link.

action_items: Neha Kapoor to send a corrected payment link
Dev Chatterjee to complete the payment using the new link
